fixed.name: Inner fence
fixed.note: Scene: tall palisade in Area1_Blockout/CampEdge, gate at x≈0 in InnerGate.

fixed.name: Spiders
fixed.note: Scene: centre of the three Monster_DarknessSpider instances, in and at the mouth of the tutorial cave.

fixed.name: Bandits
fixed.note: Scene: the Bandit instance, between the wood and arrival roads.

features.name: Mountain wall
features.note: Seals the valley. The gap on the west side lets the river and road through.

features.name: River
features.note: Rises as a spring or waterfall in the eastern mountains, runs through the lake and leaves by the western pass.

features.name: Enlarged lake
features.note: Today's lake is 20 m wide. The art shows a much larger one.

features.name: Arrival road
features.note: Follows the south bank and enters facing the fort.

features.name: Arrival gate
features.note: New north-west gate. It replaces the Civilization gate.

features.name: Palisade, south-west
features.note: Tall timber palisade. Openings are left where roads cross. West of (-31.5, -43.3) it runs along the hilltop and then the foot of the wood road, so the hill outside stays below the panel tops all the way to the wood opening.

features.name: Palisade, west
features.note: Tall timber palisade. Openings are left where roads cross.

features.name: Palisade, north
features.note: Tall timber palisade. Openings are left where roads cross.

features.name: Palisade, east
features.note: Tall timber palisade from the inner fence's east end to the quarry opening. A diagonal joins the two; north of the inner fence the lake side is open.

features.name: Palisade, south-east
features.note: Tall timber palisade. Openings are left where roads cross.

features.name: Broken palisade
features.note: 8 m collapsed stretch of the north palisade. Keeps the hunter's fire in view from the tents; it stays closed to walking.

features.name: Docks
features.note: Company docks on the camp bank, inside the compound. Off-limits at night.

features.name: Ford
features.note: Shallow crossing for the wilderness path.

features.name: Hunter's fire
features.note: Must be seen from the docks and tents at night.

features.name: Wilderness trail
features.note: Runs from the camp exit over the ford to the hunting grounds.

features.name: Ruins
features.note: On a raised ridge across the river. Must be seen from camp by day.

features.name: Hunting grounds
features.note: Work site, north of the river.

features.name: Stone quarry
features.note: Work site on high ground. Holds the sealed passage.

features.name: Quarry road
features.note: Workers walk this every morning.

features.name: Wood camp
features.note: Work site in the west forest.

features.name: Wood camp road
features.note: Branches west from the camp.

features.name: Shore rail
features.note: Knee-high broken rail with walkable gaps, built by Camp Edge. Runs from the pit's bank to the gang house, staying 3 m or more inland of the water. Workers reach the shore through the gaps, and the bank marks the stretch south of it.

features.name: Fight Pit
features.note: Round sunken floor inside a raised bank. Highest towards the fort, gap to the north. Out of sight from the fort, tolerated by the Company. w is the floor's diameter; the bank reaches 12.5 m from the centre.

features.name: Gang house
features.note: Enterable house for the top gang members, npc-003 included. Door faces the camp, back deck and dock on the lake side.

features.name: Gang dock
features.note: Short dock from the gang house's back deck into the lake.

features.name: Lakeside
features.note: Open ground between the tents and the shore. No tents for now; the night crowd, the gang and the fishing pass through it. No trees.

features.name: Ruins 2
features.note: Extra ruins in and hidden around the quarry. The sealed passage connects to them.

features.name: Fort wall, north
features.note: Tower to the ruin pieces at the gate. The ruin pillars are the foot entrance.

features.name: Fort wall, west
features.note: Tower down the west rim to the north pier of the cart gate, facing the ramp.

features.name: Fort wall, east
features.note: SM_Ruin_04 along the north rim to the hill palisade. Stays south of the rim notch, so the hoist's rim frame is outside it.

features.name: Fort tower
features.note: Stone tower on the north-west corner.

features.name: Tutorial cave
features.note: The GDD's nearby cave. It teaches dungeon exploring and looting.

features.name: Sealed cleft
features.note: Narrow open-air passage from the quarry to Ruins 2, closed by a planks-and-rubble blocker until quest-002.

features.name: Hunting camp
features.note: Clearing at the trail's end, inside the hunting grounds.

features.name: Ruins arch
features.note: Centre of the lip ruins, on the sight corridor from the tents. The arch stands just north of this point, square to the tents, so (127, 143) stays open in front of it.

features.name: Inner palisade, west
features.note: Tall palisade between the worker side and the Company yard. Meets the ring at the wood opening.

features.name: Inner palisade, east
features.note: Tall palisade between the worker side and the Company yard.

features.name: Dock spur, upper
features.note: Spur from the north palisade to the dock gate.

features.name: Dock spur, lower
features.note: Spur from the dock gate into the river.

features.name: Inner gate
features.note: The only way between the worker side and the Company yard. Everyone walks through it each morning.

features.name: Dock warehouse
features.note: Storage Hut. Built into the north palisade, door on the camp side, river door and ramp to the deck.

features.name: Dock gate
features.note: Restricted gate on the bank path from the bridge. Stands open in the blockout.

features.name: Work-gang tents
features.note: Tents along the arrival road, so the road walks past the workforce.

features.name: Latrine
features.note: Trench behind the Wretches. The poorest get the smell.

features.name: Timber yard
features.note: Logs, tally and sawpit by the wood opening. Keep the road clear.

features.name: Edric's forge
features.note: Stone hearth and chimney, open to the lane, with a small room for Edric. The clamp behind the shed feeds it.

features.name: Company store
features.note: The Storekeeper's shop. House shell with its door towards the commute.

features.name: Seasoning shed
features.note: Long open-sided roof over plank stacks: the wood side of the warehouse.

features.name: Carpenters' shop
features.note: Room with an open bay on the lane, and the cooper's lean-to at the east end.

features.name: Charcoal clamp
features.note: Earth mound behind the seasoning shed, with wood stacked beside it.

features.name: Path: Timberworks lane
features.note: Paint only. Wood road, past the forge and carpenters, to the fort road. The garrison quarter has its own path off the fort road.

features.name: Barracks and armoury
features.note: Rank-and-file guards, along the palisade under the ramp. Door to the yard. The stone east end is the locked armoury, nearest the ramp gate.

features.name: Company staff house
features.note: Lower employees: the Debt Manager and the steward under Voss. Ledger room at the west end, pay hatch and queue rail on the road side.

features.name: The Short Measure
features.note: Alehouse for guards and artisans. Door on the spine, near the cooper.

features.name: Grain store
features.note: On stilts with capped tops. Closed for now; a later theft target.

features.name: Drill yard
features.note: Pells, with butts at the west end against the bank. Doubles as the quarter's square.

features.name: Workers' graves
features.note: Numbered stakes on the low bank, with rows running along it. Local +X faces downhill.

features.name: Reserved: kennels
features.note: Empty for now.

features.name: Reserved: barber-surgeon
features.note: Empty for now, beside the barracks.

features.name: Guards' well
features.note: Guards get clean water; workers carry theirs from the river.

features.name: Alarm bell
features.note: At the spine mouth, facing the fort road and the ramp gate.

features.name: Path: garrison spine
features.note: Paint only. The one way in, from the fort road through the yard to the graves.

features.name: Path: drill yard
features.note: Paint only: the yard's trodden ground.

features.name: Stone mason's lodge
features.note: Replaces the workshop shed. Stone room to the west, walk-in cutting bay open to the road, stone stacks around it. Half finished, built from quarry offcuts.

features.name: Masons' row
features.note: Five huts backed against the inner palisade, for skilled masons who sleep behind the gate. The tool store, weighing beam and parked sledge are laid out from this point. Ridges stay under y 3.6.

features.name: Tally post
features.note: Guard hut, tally board and wash trough beside the quarry opening.

features.name: Fort hoists
features.note: Scenery. Points in order: foot crane, its rim frame, outcrop crane, its rim frame. Keep the ground round the foot crane clear: a later route may use it.

features.name: Ox pen
features.note: Railed pen along the south-east palisade. Local +Z faces the yard.

features.name: Rubble tip
features.note: Waste stone outside the east wall, north of the quarry road.

features.name: Path: sledge track
features.note: Side track from the quarry road, round the lodge's east and south sides, to the foot crane.

features.name: Canteen walkway
features.note: Boards from the stage side to the canteen.

features.name: Path: arrival
features.note: Escort route along the arrival lane: arrival opening, past the punishment post, to the player's tent.

features.name: Path: morning commute
features.note: The muddiest. Player's tent, past the square, inner gate, yard, then the wood or quarry opening. The Company Road stays clean on top of it at the gate.

features.name: Path: daily
features.note: Narrow foot-worn line: player's tent, canteen, latrine. It skirts the square's north side.

features.name: Path: night
features.note: Fight pit, wilderness opening, bank, docks, away from the inner gate.

features.name: Camp centre
features.note: Cleared square where the arrival path meets the Company Road. The raised punishment post stands in the middle, with Company flags round it. Tent-free sight lanes run from the post to the arrival gate, the wilderness opening and the inner gate. Workers don't gather here.

features.name: Path: camp square
features.note: Paint only: the trodden square round the punishment post.

features.name: Player's tent
features.note: Deep in the Player's Zone. The tent mate's tent is next door, with the tool repair trunk between them; the campfire and card game are in front. The back opening looks through the broken palisade at the hunter's fire.

features.name: Tents: Player's Zone
features.note: Each point is a standard tent, facing the nearest Player's Zone fire. Worn but not destitute.

features.name: Fire: Player's Zone south
features.note: Shared fire for the tents between the square and the inner fence.

features.name: Tents: Wretches' Corner
features.note: Each point is a low lean-to with a bedroll, facing the shared fire. The latrine is behind them.

features.name: Fire: Wretches' Corner
features.note: One fire pit for the whole corner.

features.name: Tents: Mafia Zone
features.note: Each point is a wall tent on a plank platform with an awning, facing the gang's fire.

features.name: Fire: Mafia Zone
features.note: The gang's fire, with benches.

features.name: Black market
features.note: Gang-run wall tent with a counter at the Mafia Zone's north end, on the night path towards the gang house. Open at night. Local +Z faces out of the door.

features.name: Drainage ditch
features.note: Marks the Player's Zone / Mafia Zone border in line with the dock spur. A dark strip with plank crossings, no collider.

features.name: Company compound
features.note: North bank between the arrival towers and the dock spur. Fenced on the west and closed by the river. No trees.

features.name: Compound fence, upper
features.note: From the arrival gate tower to the compound gate.

features.name: Compound fence, lower
features.note: From the compound gate into the river, past wading depth.

features.name: Compound gate
features.note: Delivery gate off the arrival road. Stands open in the blockout.

features.name: Staging yard
features.note: Cart shed, crates and sacks, smokehouse, net racks and gutting table. West of the tents-to-fire strip; keeps north of the delivery road.

features.name: Dock guard post
features.note: Enterable guard house in the palisade corner by the compound gate, with lockup cage, tally shed and bell post. Yaw turns its front to the delivery road.

features.name: Guard post walkway
features.note: Boards from the guard house ramp, round the gate lean-to, to the delivery road. Move the start if the ramp foot moves.

features.name: Company Road
features.note: Cobbled: the one clean surface in the camp. Warehouse, tents, inner gate, yard, fort gate. Paint only, no grading.

features.name: Delivery road
features.note: Off the arrival road, through the compound gate, to the warehouse river ramp. Paint only.

features.name: Palisade, ramp gate to rim
features.note: Closes the ring between the ramp gate and the fort's west wall.

features.name: Palisade, hill rim
features.note: The back of the fort: from outer-fence-5's end round the east and south rims to the south pier of the cart gate, about 1.5 m inside the rim.

features.name: Fort gate
features.note: Where the fort ramp passes through the palisade, square to the road. Local +X faces out of the camp, so the leaves swing back beside the ramp. The eastern of the twin ramp gates; fields-gate is the western.

features.name: Fields gate
features.note: The western of the twin ramp gates: an open way (posts and lintel, no leaves) through the palisade onto the plain, where path-farm leads to the farm. Built by Sites under RampGate/FieldsGate. Local +X faces out of the camp. outer-fence Panel_001 and Panel_002 are removed by saved hand edits to open it.

features.name: Fort cart gate
features.note: Wide entrance at the top of the ramp, between stone piers. Local +X faces into the fort.

features.name: Ramp rail
features.note: Unbroken rail along the ramp's outer edge, built by Camp Edge, from beside the fort gate's open south leaf to the cart gate. The farm track leaves by the fields gate instead.

features.name: Path: fort road
features.note: Paint only: Company Road to the ramp foot, west of the wooden cover at (-9, -46).

features.name: Path: fort ramp
features.note: The graded cart ramp, foot to fort. Tools/World/Grade Area 1 Fort Ramp shapes the ground along it; capture the sculpt afterwards.

features.name: Company farm
features.note: The plain behind the fort hill. No trees grow here; the fields and the farmyard sit inside it.

features.name: Farm manager's house
features.note: The Company reeve's house, outside the palisade by the ramp gate. Door east onto the farm track; kitchen garden behind it.

features.name: Tithe barn
features.note: The camp's main grain store. Closed, solid cart doors on the yard: a later theft target for the worker path.

features.name: Threshing floor
features.note: Open roof on posts over a stone floor, with flails.

features.name: Ox mill
features.note: Open round shed: an ox walks the sweep that turns the millstone. w is the diameter.

features.name: Ox byre
features.note: Stalls open north to the yard (local +Z). The farm's oxen work the mill and are bred here; the Stoneworks keeps its own team.

features.name: Ox paddock
features.note: Railed paddock behind the byre, with cows and calves.

features.name: Hay yard
features.note: Haystacks and an open hay shed: fodder for both herds.

features.name: Dung heap
features.note: Byre muck, spread on the fields.

features.name: Farm well
features.note: Well and trough in the middle of the yard.

features.name: Field gang tally
features.note: Tally board, tool rack and water barrel where the field gang is counted out and in.

features.name: Field: wheat
features.note: Bread for the fort.

features.name: Field: barley
features.note: Ale for The Short Measure and the workers' gruel.

features.name: Field: oats
features.note: Fodder for the oxen.

features.name: Field: hay meadow
features.note: Hay for the oxen. Stays grass.

features.name: Field: kitchen garden
features.note: Turnips and cabbages for the canteen, behind the manager's house.

features.name: Path: farm track
features.note: Paint only. Ramp gate, down the farm step in the rail gap, past the manager's house to the farmyard.

features.name: Path: field lane
features.note: Paint only. Yard to the wheat, barley and oats.
